value.answer: My pick is Messi. It's close with Pelé and Maradona, but Messi did it at the highest level for the longest stretch, won at club and international level, and was the best player in the world for well over a decade. I can't check the latest news right now, so anything from this season is outside what I know, but the case for him doesn't depend on that. Pelé's the argument from the other side: he won three World Cups in an era with much less top-level competition, so it's a real debate.
